capabilities.title: Keep a useful-work trail and reviewed return
capabilities.delivers: A local operator notebook can record proposed help, self-reported work and a separate review; not a public matching service.
capabilities.requires: An operator must run the local workbench; no human identity or benefit is verified.

capabilities.title: Inspect the publicly reviewed project catalog
capabilities.delivers: A curated public index describes selected projects and their maturity, without giving execution permission.
capabilities.requires: Published descriptions are not evidence that a provider is accepting requests.
